name: xcresult-summary
description: GitHub Action that reports build results, test results and code coverage from .xcresult bundles

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --legal-comments=none --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
